settings.question: How do I choose the right size?
settings.answer: We provide a size guide on each of the product page - check the product you're interested in. It lists exact measurements to help you pick the best fit.

settings.question: Do I need to create an account to order?
settings.answer: No, you can checkout as a guest. However, creating an account lets you track orders, save your wishlist, and speed up future checkouts.

settings.question: Can I return my order?
settings.answer: Yes, we accept returns within 15 days of delivery. Items must be unworn, unwashed, and in their original condition with all tags attached.

settings.question: Can I exchange my order?
settings.answer: Yes, exchanges for a different size or color are subject to availability. Select Exchange when initiating your return and specify your preference.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards, UPI, net banking, and prepaid wallets. Cash on delivery is available on select pin codes.

settings.question: How can I contact the customer service?
settings.answer: You can reach us at Support@bluer.co.in or call +91 9321466133. Our team is available Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 7 PM IST.

settings.question: Can I try clothes in-store?
settings.answer: Currently BLUER operates online only. We plan to open physical stores soon — follow us on Instagram for updates.

settings.question: How long does a return take?
settings.answer: Once we receive and inspect your return, refunds are processed within 5-7 business days to your original payment method.

settings.question: When will I receive my order?
settings.answer: Standard delivery takes 5-7 business days. Express delivery (2-3 business days) is available at checkout for most pin codes.

settings.question: How can I collaborate with you?
settings.answer: For collaboration enquiries, please email us at support@bluer.co.in with your portfolio or proposal. We will get back to you within 3-5 business days.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order ships, you will receive a tracking link via email. You can also log in to your account and view your order status under My Purchases.

settings.question: How can I use the coupon code?
settings.answer: Enter your coupon code in the Discount field at checkout before completing your payment. Only one code can be applied per order.

settings.contact_description: We're here to make your experience seamless - Reach out for any assistance.
